data.description:
# Review and improve the 100-sound recipe book — Intake Brief

**Work Item:** TF-0MV290BG8003GXXH | **Type:** docs | **Priority:** Medium

> **Headline:** Review the existing `docs/recipe-book/` (index + 100 recipe pages +
> 10 capstone pages), fix its broken links and invalid CLI commands at the
> generator source, and add a "Working with the CLI" section to the index that
> shows how to **find**, **evaluate** and **understand how these sounds were
> created** — backed by tests that keep the book honest.

## Problem statement

The casual-game recipe book already exists (`docs/recipe-book/`), but it has
never been reviewed end-to-end and contains correctness defects and a content
gap: 121 broken relative links, an invalid `toneforge show` command repeated on
all 100 recipe pages, tests that only check for marker presence rather than
block freshness or link validity, and no CLI-workflow guidance in the index. As
a result a reader cannot reliably move from "I want a sound" to finding,
auditioning and understanding it using the documented commands.

## Users

- **Game developers** prototyping casual/arcade games who need to discover and
  audition the 100-sound library from the CLI.
- **Sound designers / technical artists** reading each recipe page to understand
  how a sound was built and how to vary it.
- **ToneForge maintainers** who need the book to stay mechanically in sync with
  the recipes and generators.

Example user stories:

- As a developer, I want a single page that tells me how to find a sound by
  keyword/category/tag and audition it, so I do not have to piece commands
  together from several demos.
- As a sound designer, I want the CLI commands on a recipe page to actually run,
  so I can trust the book as a reference.
- As a maintainer, I want the test suite to fail when a link breaks or a CLI
  block goes stale, so the book cannot silently drift.

## Acceptance Criteria

- All local relative links in `docs/recipe-book/` resolve: a link-integrity check (new or extended) passes for `index.md`, `_template.md`, all 100 recipe pages and all 10 capstone pages, with zero broken local targets.
- Every CLI command shown in the book is valid: `toneforge show --recipe <name>` is replaced by the correct positional form (`toneforge show <name>`) on all 100 recipe pages, and the generators that emit it are corrected so a regeneration produces the same, valid output (second run byte-identical).
- `docs/recipe-book/index.md` gains a **Working with the CLI** section covering **find** (`list recipes` with `--search`/`--category`/`--tags`/`--json`, `show`, `library list`/`library search`), **evaluate** (`generate`, `play`, `analyze`, `classify`, `explore`, `visualize`, `tui`) and **understand how they were created** (`show`, the page's `## Sound design` section, `presets/recipes/*.yaml`, the ToneGraph schema/node-kind index) — with copy-paste commands, and linked from `README.md` § Documentation.
- `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` enforces **real** CLI-block freshness (regenerate and compare, not just marker presence) and link integrity, and the capstone CLI blocks carry machine-readable markers so they are covered too.
- All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including code comments, README, and any relevant wiki or docs site entries.
- Full project test suite must pass with the new changes. 
## Constraints

- **Fix the generators, not the pages.** Correct `scripts/recipe-book/*.ts` and
  regenerate `docs/recipe-book/*`; hand-editing generated pages is out of scope.
  Regeneration must remain idempotent (second run byte-identical).
- **No change to recipe content or architecture** — the recipe YAML, roster,
  registry and sound design are untouched.
- **Preserve the book's conventions** — front matter (`title`/`id`/`order`/
  `description`), roster order, tier structure and all existing green gates.
- **UK English** throughout.
- The tier-aware per-page CLI blocks (progressive tooling) are **out of scope**
  and tracked as follow-up **TF-0MV4Z4O8I008IZZX**.

## Existing state

- `docs/recipe-book/` contains `index.md`, `_template.md`, one page per recipe
  (100) and one page per capstone (10).
- `scripts/recipe-book/` contains `generate-index.ts`, `generate-pages.ts`,
  `generate-cli-blocks.ts`, `generate-capstones.ts` and `recipe-meta.ts`.
- `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` gates schema validity, determinism,
  non-silence, page presence, index order, tags and marker presence — but
  **not** block freshness or links.
- `README.md` links the book from § Documentation.
- Verified defects: `../../tonegraph.md` on 101 pages (file is
  `docs/tonegraph.md`); `../../prd/{STACK,SEQUENCER}_PRD.md` on the 10 capstone
  pages (files are `docs/prd/…`); `toneforge show --recipe <name>` on all 100
  recipe pages (command requires a positional name).

## Desired change

- Correct the link targets and the `show` command in the content generators and
  regenerate every page, `_template.md` and `index.md`.
- Add the **Working with the CLI** section to the generated index (find /
  evaluate / understand-creation) and reference it from `README.md`.
- Add machine-readable markers around capstone CLI blocks.
- Strengthen `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts`: validate CLI blocks by
  regeneration and add a link-integrity assertion across the book.
- Create and link the follow-up item for tier-aware CLI blocks
  (**TF-0MV4Z4O8I008IZZX**, created).

## Key Files (predicted)

- `scripts/recipe-book/generate-cli-blocks.ts` — fix the invalid `show` command; keep it the single source of block text.
- `scripts/recipe-book/generate-pages.ts` — fix the `show` command and the `../../tonegraph.md` link; reuse the shared block builder.
- `scripts/recipe-book/generate-capstones.ts` — fix `../../prd/…` links; add CLI-block markers.
- `scripts/recipe-book/generate-index.ts` — add the **Working with the CLI** section (idempotent).
- `docs/recipe-book/index.md`, `docs/recipe-book/_template.md`, `docs/recipe-book/*.md` — regenerated output.
- `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` — real CLI freshness + link integrity.
- `README.md` — link the CLI-workflow section / confirm the book entry.

## Risks & assumptions

- **Risk: documentation drift.** The book is generated; a partial fix could be
  overwritten on the next run. *Mitigation:* fix the generators first, regenerate,
  and let the strengthened tests fail on any divergence.
- **Risk: scope creep.** The review will surface further opportunities (e.g.
  tier-aware blocks, richer pages). *Mitigation:* the follow-up is already
  recorded as `TF-0MV4Z4O8I008IZZX`; new ideas become separate `discovered-from`
  items, not this scope.
- **Risk: link-checker false positives** (anchors, absolute URLs, generated
  pages). *Mitigation:* strip `#fragment`s, skip absolute/external URLs, and
  resolve targets relative to each page as the renderer would.
- **Risk: index generation is source-parsed and must stay idempotent.**
  *Mitigation:* add the new section as static generated text and assert a second
  run produces no diff.
- **Assumption:** all remaining `toneforge show`/`list`/`library`/`analyze`/
  `classify`/`explore`/`visualize` commands used in the new section run against
  the current CLI; the implementation validates them.
- **Assumption:** the audience is developers / sound designers working from the
  CLI, and this remains prose documentation (no new demo or web UI).

## Related work (manual)

- `Casual Game Recipe Book: 100 Documented Recipes from Simple to Stings (TF-0MUY9H7QZ000UX5W)` — completed parent epic that produced the book.
- `Tier-aware recipe-book CLI blocks (progressive tooling per tier) (TF-0MV4Z4O8I008IZZX)` — follow-up created by this intake (option B deferred).
- `Sound Module Index — catalogue all modules by primary function (TF-0MV29HYZU001WUW7)` — in-flight docs index; a candidate link for the "how they were created" material.
- `docs/guides/gamedev-workflow-example.md` — precedent CLI discover→inspect→iterate guide.
- `demos/recipe-filtering.md`, `demos/library.md`, `demos/exploration.md`, `demos/classification.md`, `demos/audio-analysis.md`, `demos/machine-use.md` — existing coverage of the individual CLI surfaces.
- `docs/tonegraph.md`, `docs/guides/external-recipes.md` — recipe authoring references.

## Appendix: Clarifying questions & answers

Round 1 asked whether a new document should be created; the producer corrected
the premise — the recipe book already exists and should be reviewed/improved.

- **Q1 (round 1 — document form & location).** New `docs/guides/` guide,
  `docs/recipe-book/README.md`, extend `index.md`, or a `demos/` walkthrough?
  - **Answer (producer, interactive reply):** the book already exists
    (`index.md` + pages); **review and improve that** — do not create a new
    document.
  - Research: confirmed `docs/recipe-book/` holds `index.md`, 100 recipe pages,
    10 capstone pages and `_template.md`, generated by `scripts/recipe-book/*.ts`.
- **Q2 (round 1 — coverage).** How much of the CLI (find / evaluate / understand
  creation / capstones) should be covered?
  - **Answer (producer, interactive reply):** folded into the improve-the-book
    direction; round 2 fixed the scope.
- **Q3 (round 1 — drift protection).** Should documented commands/links be
  machine-verified?
  - **Answer (producer, interactive reply):** yes — carried into round 2 option A.
- **Q4 (round 2 — improvement scope).** (A) fix defects + add CLI-workflow
  section to the index + strengthen tests; (B) A plus tier-aware per-page CLI
  blocks; (C) defects only.
  - **Answer (producer, interactive reply):** **A**, **with a follow-up item for
    B**. Evidence: created `TF-0MV4Z4O8I008IZZX`.
- **Q5 (round 2 — placement of the CLI-workflow content).** Extend
  `docs/recipe-book/index.md`; new `docs/recipe-book/README.md`; or
  `docs/guides/` linked from the index.
  - **Answer (producer, interactive reply):** **A — extend
    `docs/recipe-book/index.md`.**

## Related work (automated report)

### Related work items
- **TF-0MLYG5SUM0F6C40K** – Batch Generation Demo Walkthrough (completed)
- **TF-0MLYG50L81AVET0U** – CLI Help and Flag Validation (completed)
- **TF-0MM64O3VT13YE9SG** – Update library demo commentary for embedding-based similarity (completed)

### Repository file matches
- `standups/2026_10_05.md` — matched: cli, create, created, document, documentation (+11 more)
- `CHANGELOG.md` — matched: cli, create, document, documentation, find (+10 more)
- `docs/prd/DEMO_ROADMAP.md` — matched: cli, create, document, etc, evaluate (+10 more)

data.description:
Make each recipe-book page's `## ToneForge CLI` block **tier-aware**, so it demonstrates the pipeline stage appropriate to that tier instead of repeating the same four commands on all 100 pages.

**Discovered-from:** TF-0MV290BG8003GXXH

## Background

The parent epic `TF-0MUY9H7QZ000UX5W` (casual game recipe book) required each tier to illustrate the tooling stage appropriate to it (Tier 3 → `analyze`/`classify`/`explore`, Tier 4 → `sequence`, etc.). The delivered generator (`scripts/recipe-book/generate-cli-blocks.ts` and the duplicate in `generate-pages.ts`) emits an identical block for every recipe — `generate` ×2, `show`, `list recipes` — so the book does not teach the pipeline progessively. This was identified during the intake review of `TF-0MV290BG8003GXXH` and explicitly deferred as a follow-up.

## Desired change (indicative — to be defined at intake)

- Derive the CLI block from the roster entry's `tier` (and, for capstones, the arrangement kind) so each tier shows the commands that surface its capability.
- Add machine-readable markers around capstone CLI blocks so they can be freshness-checked.
- Keep generation idempotent and extend `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` to validate the tier-specific blocks.

## Notes

This item is a follow-up and does **not** block `TF-0MV290BG8003GXXH`.

## Goal

As a ToneForge maintainer I want every local relative link in the recipe book to resolve, and a test that fails when one breaks, so the book cannot silently drift into 404s.

**Parent:** TF-0MV290BG8003GXXH — Review the 100 sound library documentation. This is slice 1 of 5 (vertical slices: links → CLI blocks → capstone markers → CLI-workflow section → verification).

## Target outcome

`docs/recipe-book/` contains zero broken local relative links (currently 121 broken links across 111 pages), enforced by a link-integrity test that covers `index.md`, `_template.md`, the 100 recipe pages and the 10 capstone pages.

## Definition of done

- The generated `## See also` links target real files: `../../tonegraph.md` → `../tonegraph.md` (101 pages, including `_template.md`) and `../../prd/STACK_PRD.md` / `../../prd/SEQUENCER_PRD.md` → `../prd/…` (10 capstone pages).
- The corrections live in the generators (`scripts/recipe-book/generate-pages.ts`, `scripts/recipe-book/generate-capstones.ts`); `_template.md` is hand-maintained — no script emits it — so it is edited directly and that is recorded in a code comment.
- Affected pages are regenerated and a second regeneration is byte-identical.
- A link-integrity test in `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` resolves every inline link relative to its page and fails with the offending page + target.
- `npx vitest run src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` passes.

## Constraints

- Fix the generators and regenerate; do not hand-edit generated pages. `_template.md` is the only direct page edit (it has no generator).
- No changes to recipe YAML, roster, registry or sound design.
- Preserve front matter, roster order, tier structure and every existing green gate; UK English throughout.

## Risky assumptions

- The book uses only inline `[text](target)` links. Mitigation: the test asserts the number of parsed links, so reference-style links cannot slip through unparsed.
- Anchor-only links (`#section`), absolute URLs and external hosts are out of scope for resolution.

## Acceptance Criteria

- All local relative links in `docs/recipe-book/` resolve: a link-integrity check (new or extended) passes for `index.md`, `_template.md`, all 100 recipe pages and all 10 capstone pages, with zero broken local targets.
- `../../tonegraph.md` no longer appears in any recipe-book page and `../../prd/` no longer appears in any capstone page; the generator sources are corrected so regeneration reproduces the correct links.
- `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` resolves every inline link relative to its page, skips `#fragment`s, absolute URLs and external hosts, and reports the offending page and target on failure.
- Regenerating with `tsx scripts/recipe-book/generate-pages.ts` and `tsx scripts/recipe-book/generate-capstones.ts` twice produces byte-identical output, leaving `git status --porcelain docs/recipe-book` clean.
- The recipe-book test file passes.

## Key Files

- `scripts/recipe-book/generate-pages.ts` — fix the `../../tonegraph.md` target.
- `scripts/recipe-book/generate-capstones.ts` — fix the `../../prd/…` targets.
- `docs/recipe-book/_template.md` — hand-maintained template; fix the `../../tonegraph.md` target.
- `docs/recipe-book/index.md` — index plus the 100 recipe and 10 capstone pages as regenerated output.
- `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` — link-integrity gate.

## Dependencies

None — this is the first slice and unblocks the CLI-block slices.

## Deliverables

Correct link targets in the generators and the template, regenerated pages, and a link-integrity gate in the recipe-book test battery.

data.description:
## Goal

As a sound designer I want the CLI commands on every recipe page to actually run, and a test that proves the committed blocks match what the generator emits, so I can trust the book as a reference.

**Parent:** TF-0MV290BG8003GXXH — Review the 100 sound library documentation. This is slice 2 of 5 (vertical slices: links → CLI blocks → capstone markers → CLI-workflow section → verification).

## Target outcome

Every recipe page documents `toneforge show <name>` (positional), all CLI-block text comes from one shared builder, and a regeneration-based freshness test fails whenever a committed block diverges from the generator.

## Definition of done

- `toneforge show --recipe <name>` is replaced by `toneforge show <name>` (the command requires a positional name) in `scripts/recipe-book/generate-cli-blocks.ts` and in the duplicate builder inside `scripts/recipe-book/generate-pages.ts`.
- The duplicated command list is replaced by one exported `buildCliBlock(name)` used by both scripts, so block text has a single source of truth.
- `expectCliBlockFresh` in `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` regenerates the block with the shared builder and compares it byte-for-byte with the block committed between the markers, rather than only asserting that markers exist.
- All 100 recipe pages are regenerated; a second regeneration is byte-identical.
- `toneforge show <name>` is executed successfully against the real CLI for a sample of at least three book recipes.

## Constraints

- Fix the generators and regenerate; no hand edits to generated pages.
- Do not change the block's command set beyond the `show` correction (tier-aware per-page blocks remain out of scope, tracked as TF-0MV4Z4O8I008IZZX).
- Preserve the `CLI_BLOCK_START` / `CLI_BLOCK_END` marker convention and UK English.

## Risky assumptions

- `scripts/recipe-book/generate-cli-blocks.ts` is a standalone CLI script not imported elsewhere. Mitigation: grep for imports before refactoring both generators onto one helper.
- `toneforge show` accepts a positional recipe name and not `--recipe` (verified with `toneforge show --help`).

## Acceptance Criteria

- Every CLI command shown in the book is valid: `toneforge show --recipe <name>` is replaced by the correct positional form (`toneforge show <name>`) on all 100 recipe pages, and the generators that emit it are corrected so a regeneration produces the same, valid output (second run byte-identical).
- A single shared block builder is the only source of CLI-block text, used by both `scripts/recipe-book/generate-cli-blocks.ts` and `scripts/recipe-book/generate-pages.ts` (no duplicated command list).
- `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` fails when a committed block is edited out of sync, by regenerating the block and comparing it byte-for-byte with the committed block between the markers.
- `toneforge show <recipe-name>` succeeds on the CLI for at least three book recipes, and the corrected pages carry that exact form.
- Regeneration is idempotent (second run byte-identical) and the recipe-book test file passes.

## Key Files

- `scripts/recipe-book/generate-cli-blocks.ts` — fix the `show` command; export the shared builder.
- `scripts/recipe-book/generate-pages.ts` — use the shared builder; fix the `show` command.
- `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` — real regeneration-and-compare freshness gate.
- `docs/recipe-book/*.md` — regenerated recipe pages output.

## Dependencies

Blocked by the link-integrity slice (both slices edit `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` and `generate-pages.ts`; serialising avoids conflicts).

## Deliverables

A shared CLI-block builder with a valid `show` command, 100 regenerated recipe pages, and a genuine freshness gate in the recipe-book test battery.
data.title: Recipe-book CLI-block freshness gate and valid show command

## Goal

As a ToneForge maintainer I want the capstone CLI blocks to be machine-verifiable, so the commands on the 10 capstone pages cannot go stale without failing the suite.

**Parent:** TF-0MV290BG8003GXXH — Review the 100 sound library documentation. This is slice 3 of 5 (vertical slices: links → CLI blocks → capstone markers → CLI-workflow section → verification).

## Target outcome

Each of the 10 capstone pages wraps its CLI commands in `<!-- CLI_BLOCK_START … -->` … `<!-- CLI_BLOCK_END -->` markers emitted by the generator, and the freshness gate covers them as well as the 100 recipe pages.

## Definition of done

- `scripts/recipe-book/generate-capstones.ts` emits markers around the capstone CLI block, using the same convention and regeneration hint as the recipe pages.
- The 10 capstone pages are regenerated and a second run is byte-identical.
- The freshness gate in `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` covers the 10 capstone pages in addition to the 100 recipe pages.
- The capstone commands (`toneforge stack …`, `toneforge sequence …`) are validated against the CLI.
- Capstone narrative, structure and preset data are unchanged — markers only.

## Constraints

- Reuse the existing recipe-page marker convention; do not invent a second format.
- No changes to capstone preset JSON, narrative text or `## At a glance` tables.
- Preserve idempotent generation; UK English.

## Risky assumptions

- The capstone CLI renderer (`renderCli`) is deterministic, so wrapping it in markers does not affect idempotence. Mitigation: assert a byte-identical second run.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Every one of the 10 capstone pages contains a `<!-- CLI_BLOCK_START` marker and a matching `<!-- CLI_BLOCK_END -->` marker wrapping its CLI commands.
- The markers are emitted by `scripts/recipe-book/generate-capstones.ts`, so regeneration reproduces them (second run byte-identical).
- The `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` freshness gate covers all 10 capstone pages and fails if a capstone block is edited out of sync.
- The commands inside the capstone blocks resolve on the CLI (`toneforge stack` and `toneforge sequence` usage verified).

## Key Files

- `scripts/recipe-book/generate-capstones.ts` — emit the CLI-block markers.
- `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` — extend the freshness gate to capstone pages.
- `docs/recipe-book/*_stack.md` — regenerated capstone output.
- `docs/recipe-book/*_sequence.md` — regenerated capstone output.

## Dependencies

Blocked by the CLI-block freshness slice (it extends that slice's freshness helper and edits the same test file).

## Deliverables

Marker-emitting capstone generator, 10 regenerated capstone pages, and freshness coverage for capstone CLI blocks.

## Goal

As a game developer I want one page that shows how to find, evaluate and understand the 100 sounds from the CLI, so I do not have to piece commands together from several demo walkthroughs.

**Parent:** TF-0MV290BG8003GXXH — Review the 100 sound library documentation. This is slice 4 of 5 (vertical slices: links → CLI blocks → capstone markers → CLI-workflow section → verification).

## Target outcome

`docs/recipe-book/index.md` gains a generated **Working with the CLI** section covering find / evaluate / understand-creation with copy-pasteable commands, linked from `README.md` § Documentation.

## Definition of done

- `scripts/recipe-book/generate-index.ts` emits the section as static generated text; a second run is byte-identical.
- The section covers:
  - **Find** — `toneforge list recipes --search <text>`, `--category <name>`, `--tags casual`, `--json`; `toneforge show <name>`; `toneforge library list` and `toneforge library search`.
  - **Evaluate** — `toneforge generate --recipe <name> --output <file.wav>`, `toneforge play <file.wav>`, `toneforge analyze`, `toneforge classify`, `toneforge explore`, `toneforge visualize`, `toneforge tui`.
  - **Understand how they were created** — `toneforge show <name>`, the page's `## Sound design` section, `presets/recipes/*.yaml`, and the ToneGraph schema / node-kind material (`../tonegraph.md`, and `../modules/index.md` when it lands).
- `README.md` § Documentation links the CLI-workflow material.
- A test asserts the section exists and that every recipe / stack / sequence name it references resolves (registry or `presets/`).
- Every command in the section is valid against the current CLI.

## Constraints

- Extend the generated `docs/recipe-book/index.md`; do not add a new document (a separate `docs/recipe-book/README.md` was rejected at intake).
- Keep the existing catalogue structure, front matter and roster order intact.
- Prose documentation only — no new demo, web UI or CLI behaviour. Match the real CLI (`--help` verified). UK English.

## Risky assumptions

- The named commands and flags exist in the current CLI. Verified via `--help` for `show`, `list`, `library`, `play`, `analyze`, `classify`, `explore`, `visualize`, `tui` and `generate`; the implementing session re-validates by running them.
- The section stays scannable: one short command block per surface rather than a full tutorial.
- `docs/modules/index.md` (TF-0MV29HYZU001WUW7) may still be in review; the link is added only if the file exists, otherwise the ToneGraph reference is used.

## Acceptance Criteria

- `docs/recipe-book/index.md` gains a **Working with the CLI** section covering **find** (`list recipes` with `--search`/`--category`/`--tags`/`--json`, `show`, `library list`/`library search`), **evaluate** (`generate`, `play`, `analyze`, `classify`, `explore`, `visualize`, `tui`) and **understand how they were created** (`show`, the page's `## Sound design` section, `presets/recipes/*.yaml`, the ToneGraph schema/node-kind index) — with copy-paste commands, and linked from `README.md` § Documentation.
- The section is emitted by `scripts/recipe-book/generate-index.ts` and survives regeneration byte-identically.
- A test asserts the section exists and that every recipe / stack / sequence name referenced in it resolves (registry or `presets/`).
- Every command shown in the section is valid against the current CLI (executed or checked with `--help`).
- All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including code comments, README, and any relevant wiki or docs site entries.
- The recipe-book test file passes.

## Key Files

- `scripts/recipe-book/generate-index.ts` — emit the Working with the CLI section.
- `docs/recipe-book/index.md` — regenerated index with the new section.
- `./README.md` — link the CLI-workflow material from § Documentation.
- `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` — section-presence and referenced-name test.

## Dependencies

Blocked by the CLI-block freshness slice (shares the test file and the regenerated book baseline).

## Deliverables

Generated CLI-workflow section in the recipe-book index, README link, and a test that keeps the section's referenced names honest.

data.description:
## Goal

As a ToneForge maintainer I want an end-to-end verification that the whole book is reproducible and every documented command runs, so the review is provably complete rather than assumed.

**Parent:** TF-0MV290BG8003GXXH — Review the 100 sound library documentation. This is slice 5 of 5 (vertical slices: links → CLI blocks → capstone markers → CLI-workflow section → verification).

## Target outcome

All recipe-book generators are run twice with byte-identical output, every command documented in the book is validated against the CLI, and the full project test suite passes.

## Definition of done

- All generators (`generate-pages.ts`, `generate-cli-blocks.ts`, `generate-capstones.ts`, `generate-index.ts`) are run twice; the second run leaves `git status --porcelain docs/recipe-book` empty.
- Every `toneforge …` command documented in the book is extracted and validated — executed where safe and cheap, otherwise its verb/flags checked against `--help` — with the results recorded in a work-item comment.
- `npm run typecheck` and the full `npm test` suite pass.
- Any command that does not run is either fixed in the owning generator or captured as a `discovered-from` follow-up, never silently ignored.

## Constraints

- Verification only: do not add new features beyond what the sibling slices deliver, and do not change recipe content or architecture.
- Use temporary output paths for commands that write files (`generate`, `visualize`) and clean up afterwards; never commit generated churn.
- UK English.

## Risky assumptions

- `toneforge tui` is interactive and cannot be executed headlessly. Mitigation: validate it via `--help`/usage instead of launching it.
- Some commands require audio device access (`play`). Mitigation: validate usage/`--help` and use a known existing WAV only when a player is available.

## Acceptance Criteria

- `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` enforces **real** CLI-block freshness (regenerate and compare, not just marker presence) and link integrity, and the capstone CLI blocks carry machine-readable markers so they are covered too.
- Running every recipe-book generator twice leaves `git status --porcelain docs/recipe-book` empty (byte-identical regeneration), and the result is recorded on the parent item.
